name: Security Godmode — LLM Red-Team Lab
description: Opt-in prompt robustness testing, transformation, refusal scoring, and bounded multi-model comparison for authorized LLM red-team work.
author: binsarjr

variables.name: AUTO_CONTEXT_ENABLED
variables.label: Allow per-agent Godmode injection
variables.description: Master switch for direct per-agent system prompt and ephemeral prefill injection.

agent_settings.name: enabled
agent_settings.label: Godmode injection
agent_settings.description: Inject a model-family Godmode profile on every turn without requiring a tool call. Injection remains blocked until the authorization record below is valid.

agent_settings.name: authorization_confirmed
agent_settings.label: Authorization confirmed
agent_settings.description: Operator attestation that the recorded scope is approved. Godmode fails closed when this is disabled.

agent_settings.name: authorization_scope
agent_settings.label: Authorization scope
agent_settings.description: Exact approved targets and activities. User messages cannot expand this stored scope.

agent_settings.name: authorized_by
agent_settings.label: Authorized by
agent_settings.description: Operator, owner, or approval ticket responsible for this authorization.

agent_settings.name: authorization_expires_at
agent_settings.label: Authorization expiry
agent_settings.description: Required ISO-8601 expiry with timezone, for example 2026-09-09T23:59:59+07:00.

agent_settings.name: force_transform
agent_settings.label: Force request transform
agent_settings.description: Transform each new user request with the saved encoding, or L33T when no encoding is saved, while retaining the active system prompt and prefill.
